subject: economics
title: Equilibrium Adventure
welcome_lead: Where supply meets demand — that's the magic price. ⚖️
meta_desc: Supply & Demand Basics Adventure 3 — KS3 Economics on market equilibrium and price changes.
final_note: You learned what equilibrium is, what surpluses and shortages look like.

concepts.def: Too much supply at this price
Too little supply at this price
A change moving the whole curve

walkthroughs.body_html:
Where the supply curve crosses the demand curve = equilibrium.

Buyers want the same amount that sellers offer. Nice and balanced.

If price is too high → surplus (unsold items piling up). Sellers drop prices.

If price is too low → shortage (empty shelves). Prices rise.

Markets keep correcting themselves.

A new trend pushes the demand curve right → higher equilibrium price.

New tech pushes the supply curve right → lower equilibrium price.

Real markets shift every day. 📊
